messages.author: c72fc7caf26ddaca
messages.subject: Binary mediation using lavaan
parts:
Hello all,

I was wondering if anyone has used lavaan to estimate binary mediation models. I understand the usual approach won't work in the case of a binary mediator. I can do this in Stata, but I'd like the extra flexibility of additional estimators provided by lavaan.

The paper here [https://www.statmodel.com/download/causalmediation.pdf] discusses the issues and implementation in Mplus, but would be good to know how to implement using lavaan.

Anyone have any ideas/suggestions/comments.

Thanks.

Killian.
